Pydantic 2 TypedDict documentation and implementation.
Python <3.12 requires typing_extensions.TypedDict.
Strict mode checks field types but default extra handling discards unknown keys.
with_config(extra="forbid") rejects unknown keys, including nested records.
BaseModel uses ModelMetaclass(ABCMeta), enforcing abstractmethod.
https://docs.pydantic.dev/latest/api/standard_library_types/#typed-dictionaries
https://docs.pydantic.dev/latest/api/config/#pydantic.config.with_config
https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/blob/v2.12.5/pydantic/_internal/_model_construction.py
